ActiveProviderSettings.description: One named provider in the registry.

contextWindow.description: Context window size in tokens, when the server does not report it.

credential.description: Credential alias (openai-compatible, anthropic-api). An alias, never the API key itself.

directTool.description: MCP tool used for direct prompts (mcp).

endpointId.description: Stable local endpoint identity; when set it separates registrations that share a credential and model.

extraBody.description: Vendor-specific request fields merged into every request as a JSON merge patch: objects merge, other values replace, null deletes (openai-compatible).

implementTool.description: MCP tool used for implementation tasks (mcp).

model.description: Model identifier sent to the provider.

reasoningReplay.description: When an assistant turn's reasoning is sent back as reasoning_content (openai-compatible). Empty means auto: local/LAN servers and model families that require it.

responseHeaderTimeout.description: Seconds an openai-compatible provider may take to send response headers. 0 or unset means no limit.

toolCallFormat.description: How tool calls are carried (openai-compatible). native uses the tools request field; hermes and qwen3 put schemas in the system prompt and parse <tool_call> blocks; auto is native until the server rejects tools. Empty means native.

keepRecent.description: Recent tool results preserved during micro-compaction.

maxTriggerTokens.description: Cap on the input-token count at which auto-compaction fires. 0 or negative means no cap; unset uses the built-in cap.

reserved.description: Token budget reserved for model output when computing usable context.

DefinitionOfDoneSettings.description: Opt-in repository completion checks; each settings layer replaces this entire object.

EpisodeSettings.description: Opt-in private episode recording; content recording requires includeContent.

allowedEnvVars.description: Environment variables that may be interpolated into headers (type "http").

async.description: Fire and forget; do not wait for the hook.

if.description: Permission-rule expression that gates whether the hook fires.

once.description: Remove the hook after its first execution.

statusMessage.description: Spinner text shown while the hook runs.

type.description: How the hook runs. An empty or missing type means command. mcp_tool is a Claude Code type that conduit does not run.

HookMatcher.description: A tool-name matcher and the hooks it triggers.

hooks.description: Hooks to run when the matcher applies.

matcher.description: Tool name or glob; alternatives separated by "|". Empty matches everything.

PostToolUse.description: Run after a tool call completes.

PreToolUse.description: Run before a tool call; can allow, deny, ask or rewrite its input.

SessionStart.description: Run when a session starts, resumes, clears or compacts.

Stop.description: Run when the agent finishes responding.

TaskCompleted.description: Run when a task is completed.

TaskCreated.description: Run when a task is created.

TeammateIdle.description: Run when an agent-team teammate goes idle.

UserPromptSubmit.description: Run before a prompt reaches the model; can block it, add context or rewrite it. Matchers are ignored.

disabled.description: Do not start this language server.

env.description: Extra environment entries, in KEY=value form.

additionalDirectories.description: Extra directories file tools may operate in without prompting.

allow.description: Permission rules that run without prompting, e.g. "Bash(git status:*)".

ask.description: Permission rules that always prompt, even where an allow rule matches.

defaultMode.description: Permission mode a session starts in.

deny.description: Permission rules that are always refused.

ProviderPoolSettings.description: Provider references sharing load-aware scheduling; distinct from providerChains failover.

repetitionGuard.description: Interrupt output that has degenerated into a repeating loop. Unset means on.

maxBytes.description: Bytes before output is truncated to disk.

maxLines.description: Lines before output is truncated to disk.

keyless.description: Keyless search tier (Parallel, DuckDuckGo, Mojeek), which sends the query to third parties. auto uses it only when no other provider is usable; always also falls back to it when a configured provider fails; never disables it.

description: Conduit-owned user config at ~/.conduit/conduit.json. Keys conduit does not model are allowed.

$schema.description: URL of the JSON Schema this file follows (editor hint; ignored at load).

councilConvergenceThreshold.description: Minimum Jaccard similarity (0-1) that ends a debate early. Zero or negative disables it.

councilMemberTimeoutSec.description: Seconds each council member call may run. 0 means no timeout.

councilProviders.description: Provider keys that take part in council-mode debates. Empty disables council mode.

councilRoles.description: Maps a provider key to a council role such as architect, skeptic or perf-reviewer.

councilSynthesizer.description: Provider key used for synthesis. Empty uses the parent loop's background model.

disableMouse.description: Turn off terminal mouse capture so native selection works (tmux/ssh). Wheel scroll and click-to-expand are unavailable; use the keyboard bindings.

enableAllProjectMcpServers.description: Approve every server in the project .mcp.json.

env.description: Extra environment variables for tool execution.

hooks.description: Lifecycle hooks, keyed by event name.

lspServers.description: Per-language-server overrides keyed by language key, e.g. "go" or "typescript".

numStartups.description: Number of times conduit has started, maintained by conduit.

onboardingComplete.description: Set once the first-run welcome screen has been dismissed.

outputStyle.description: Active output style name; built-ins are default, Explanatory and Learning, and custom styles come from output-style files.

permissions.description: Tool permission rules and default mode.

projects.description: Per-project state keyed by absolute path, maintained by conduit.

providerChains.description: Maps a role to an ordered list of provider keys to fail over to on 429/503/529.

providers.description: Named provider registry; roles reference these keys.

redactSecrets.description: Mask secrets (API keys, tokens, private keys, password assignments) in tool results. Unset means on.

roles.description: Maps a role (default, main, planning, background, implement, review) to a provider key.

schemaVersion.description: Config format version, maintained by conduit.

theme.description: Active palette name: dark, light, dark-daltonized, light-daltonized, dark-ansi, light-ansi, or a custom name from themes.

themeOverrides.description: Per-field color tweaks on top of the named theme: lowercase palette field name to #RRGGBB or ANSI 0-15.

themes.description: Custom themes: theme name to a field map shaped like themeOverrides.

ttsr.description: Mid-stream rule settings beyond the rule files themselves.

usageStatusEnabled.description: Show the Claude plan usage footer.

title: Conduit conduit.json
